_note: The monthly theme for both home pages. home.js and northstar-home.js fetch this at load and merge it over their built-in defaults; if the fetch fails they keep those defaults, so a bad edit here can never take a home page down. Changing the month is an edit to this file alone.

home.label: This month’s theme
home.title: Masking
home.body: Showing a version of yourself that feels safer than the real one — in a message, on a first date, in a room full of people. What it protects, what it costs, and how you decide when to let it down.
home.novaAsk: Is it okay to mask when I’m meeting someone new?

notes.heading: Discussion Notes
notes.label: The Masks We Wear · 4-page PDF
notes.title: Did you miss our discussion? That’s okay.
notes.text: We can still share our notes with you. These notes discuss what masking can look like, why we do it, ten tips for letting the mask down at your own pace, and scripts for asking for what you need.

discussion.heading: Join
discussion.label: Discussion · On Zoom
discussion.title: The Masks We Wear
discussion.text: What masking is, why we do it, and how it shows up in friendships, dating, work, family, and everyday life. Come to listen, share, ask questions, or simply be part of the conversation.

excerpts.when-and-whether-to-disclose: How to decide what to share about a diagnosis, disability, or your history: what, with whom, and when. On your terms.
excerpts.date-or-audition: A first date isn’t a test you have to pass. How to stop performing and start finding out whether you like each other.

northstar.label: This month’s theme
northstar.title: Masking
northstar.body: Masking is when you hide parts of yourself so that other people are more comfortable. Most people do it sometimes. It can keep you safe. It can also be tiring. This month our articles are about choosing when to show more of yourself, and when not to.
northstar.novaAsk: Is it okay to mask when I’m meeting someone new?

discussion.heading: Join
discussion.label: North Star · On Zoom
discussion.title: What Is Masking?
discussion.text: A short, structured conversation about masking. We will explain what masking is, with everyday examples. You can talk, type in the chat, or just listen. Cameras are optional.
